stem.en: Aluminium ions are Al³⁺ and sulfate ions are SO₄²⁻. What is the formula of aluminium sulfate?

explanation.en: Cross the numbers: the 3 from aluminium goes to sulfate and the 2 from sulfate goes to aluminium, giving Al₂(SO₄)₃. To check, 2 × (+3) is +6 and 3 × (−2) is −6. In option b the charges are +3 and −6, so they do not add up to zero. Option c keeps each number on its own ion instead of crossing it: +9 and −4.

hints.en: Each ion's charge number becomes the subscript of the other ion. Then check that the charges add up to zero.
